Alibaba has released Qwen4-Max, the most capable model in its Qwen family, and made it available through its pay-as-you-go API. It is a mixture-of-experts model with 2.4 trillion total parameters, of which 71 billion are active per token, and it takes text, image and video inputs across a one-million-token context window. International pricing is $1.50 per million input tokens and $4.50 per million output tokens, and Alibaba says it ranked 6th on the Code Arena coding leaderboard.
